## The claim

Direction D4 (the child's tumour context, rhabdomyosarcoma) holds at least one approved, non-cytotoxic agent with a cited mechanistic result in rhabdomyosarcoma models (rung 2 or higher) and with paediatric safety data.

**Prediction if true.** A statin (HMGCR) reaches rung 2 or higher from PMID 41249736 and carries an openFDA label with a pediatric_use section or a paediatric ClinicalTrials.gov study; the cytotoxic backbone drugs (vincristine, doxorubicin) also appear but are excluded as repurposing candidates because they are the standard of care, not a repurposing.

**What would refute it.** Every D4 approved candidate with rung 2 or higher is a cytotoxic already in the rhabdomyosarcoma standard of care, or the non-cytotoxic candidates have no paediatric label section and no paediatric trial.

| 115 | neutral | 0.30 | measurement | The in-vivo half of the statin paper is genetic (DHCR7 silencing halted xenograft growth), not pharmacological, so the statin's own rung from the curated table is 2, not 3. | `methodology/113` |
